intro.text: Hi, friend! Let's make an awesome plan.

plan-prompt.text: First, make a plan. What would you like to do?

plan-tower.text: You planned to build a tower. Let's do it!

plan-garden.text: You planned to grow a garden. Let's do it!

plan-picnic.text: You planned to pack a picnic. Let's do it!

do-prompt.text: Now do your plan. Put each cozy piece where it belongs.

do-nudge.text: Almost! Look for the matching cozy outline.

do-complete.text: You did it! You followed your plan.

feeling-prompt.text: You did your plan. How did it feel?

feeling-happy.text: Happy! Your work brought a smile.

feeling-proud.text: Proud! You kept going and finished.

feeling-challenged.text: Challenged! Tricky work helps your brain grow.

feeling-calm.text: Calm! You found your steady feeling.

skill-patience.text: Patience helped you take your time.

skill-problem-solving.text: Problem solving helped you find a way.

skill-creativity.text: Creativity helped you make it your way.

reward.text: Plan, do, review! You made your day awesome.
